title: Dock not detected after sleep
text: If the dock is not detected after the laptop resumes from sleep, unplug the USB-C cable for ten seconds and reconnect it. Dock firmware 2.1.4 fixes the resume handshake. Check the version in the dock utility.

title: Error E-4012 during dock update
text: E-4012 means the update image failed signature verification. Download the package again from the support site; do not rename the file. Corporate proxies that rewrite downloads also trigger E-4012.

title: Battery stops charging at 80 percent
text: Battery care mode limits charging to 80 percent to extend battery life. Turn it off in BIOS under Power > Battery Health Manager if you need a full charge before travel.

title: External monitor black over DisplayPort
text: A monitor that shows no signal over DisplayPort through the dock usually needs the dock power-cycled. Hold the dock power button for five seconds. Daisy-chained monitors need MST enabled.

title: Laptop fan loud and hot under load
text: High fan noise and heat during video calls is normal under sustained load. Clean the vents, keep the laptop on a hard surface, and select the balanced thermal profile in the system utility.

title: Secure boot violation after BIOS change
text: A secure boot violation appears when an unsigned bootloader is detected. Re-enable the default keys in BIOS Security > Secure Boot Configuration, or reinstall the signed OS loader.

title: Ethernet on dock drops every few minutes
text: Intermittent ethernet disconnects on the dock are fixed by NIC driver 10.2.7 or later. Disable Energy Efficient Ethernet in the adapter's advanced settings as a temporary workaround.

title: Part number 5H8T2 replacement keyboard
text: Replacement keyboard assembly part 5H8T2 fits 14-inch models built after March. Earlier units use part 5H8T1. Replacement requires removing the bottom cover and battery connector first.

title: Dock reboots repeatedly
text: A dock that restarts in a loop is usually underpowered. Use the original 180 W adapter; lower-wattage USB-C power supplies cannot run the dock and charge the laptop at the same time.

title: Wi-Fi slow after waking up
text: Slow wireless after resume is caused by the adapter staying in power saving mode. Update the WLAN driver and set roaming aggressiveness to medium in the adapter properties.

title: Firmware update over the air fails
text: OTA firmware updates need at least 30 percent battery and AC power connected. If the update fails twice, run the recovery flash from the boot menu using the BIOS recovery image.

title: Error code E-7730 on dock LED
text: E-7730 shown as three amber blinks indicates the dock's thermal sensor tripped. Move the dock away from heat sources and let it cool; it recovers automatically.
